questions.question: Paul wrote that the law has authority over a man for how long?

answers.text: Only as long as he lives
Only as long as he obeys it
Only as long as he remembers it

questions.question: Paul told believers they died to the law so they could belong to someone new. Who is that?

answers.text: Him who was raised from the dead
Moses who gave them the law
Abraham the father of us all

questions.question: Paul taught that the law God gave is itself sin. True or false?
Paul said sin brought death to him through the good commandment. What was the reason for this?

answers.text: So sin would be exposed as sin
So the law would look stronger
So Paul would learn to obey
